description: Redux slice for managing user state, including fetching user info, subscriptions, and user preferences in a Mattermost-based application.

methods.name: fetchMe
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk to fetch current user info and configuration.

methods.name: fetchUserBlockSubscriptions
methods.description: Async thunk to fetch user block subscriptions, currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: setMe
methods.description: Reducer to set current user and login status.

methods.name: setBoardUsers
methods.description: Reducer to set the list of board users.

methods.name: addBoardUsers
methods.description: Reducer to add multiple users to the board users list.

methods.name: removeBoardUsersById
methods.description: Reducer to remove users from the board users list by their IDs.

methods.name: followBlock
methods.description: Reducer to add a subscription to block subscriptions.

methods.name: unfollowBlock
methods.description: Reducer to remove a subscription from block subscriptions.

methods.name: patchProps
methods.description: Reducer to update user preferences.

methods.name: getMe
methods.description: Selector to get current user info.

methods.name: getLoggedIn
methods.description: Selector to get login status.

methods.name: getBoardUsers
methods.description: Selector to get the dictionary of board users.

methods.name: getMyConfig
methods.description: Selector to get user configuration/preferences.

methods.name: getBoardUsersList
methods.description: Selector to get sorted list of board users.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Selector factory to get a specific user by ID.

methods.name: getOnboardingTourStarted
methods.description: Selector to determine if onboarding tour has started.

methods.name: getOnboardingTourStep
methods.description: Selector to get current onboarding tour step.

methods.name: getOnboardingTourCategory
methods.description: Selector to get onboarding tour category.

methods.name: getVersionMessageCanceled
methods.description: Selector to check if version message is canceled.

methods.name: getCardLimitSnoozeUntil
methods.description: Selector to get snooze timestamp for card limit.

methods.name: getCardHiddenWarningSnoozeUntil
methods.description: Selector to get snooze timestamp for hidden warning.
